| Global Liveability Index 2026 (EIU) | New Delhi 120, Mumbai 121, Chennai 123, Bengaluru 127 | Copenhagen #1 |
| Happy City Index 2026 | Jaipur 6th (only Indian city in global top 10) | London #1 |
🎯 Exam Angle → 🔥 HIGH — GPI (125th) vs Henley (81st) are two different passport indices — classic confusion trap.
